native_initialization: Use the original native finite-element state at solnum 901, preserving its mesh/DOF ordering. Both branches must install identical native vector bytes. BDF history is restarted; it is not restored from sampled tensors.

pulse.temporal_gate: sin(pi*(t-on)/(off-on))^2 for on<t<off, else 0; compact C1
pulse.unit_contract: N/m^3; read actual physics-node expressions and COMSOL numerical unit resolution
pulse.interpretation: A finite localized body force prototype; not a linear-response or actuator-fidelity claim

spatial_norm: Tensor-product trapezoidal area weights over full-domain x/y arrays, excluding the actual cylinder/invalid mask; velocity uses u and v jointly. Pressure removes the weighted spatial mean separately in each field; raw pressure mean offset is reported.
time_norm: Trapezoidal time-weighted RMS of per-frame spatial RMS, over 180..200 s

restart_acceptance.comparison: new zero branch minus the frozen uninterrupted M3 baseline at matched saved times
restart_acceptance.nature: Preregistered engineering restart-equivalence thresholds, not an exact-solution error bound

response_acceptance.noise_metric: maximum ROI velocity-vector spatial RMS(zero-baseline)/U over the full 180..200 window
response_acceptance.pre_event_metric: maximum ROI RMS(pulse-zero)/U for t<=181; compare against max(pre_event_floor,2*maximum zero-baseline ROI error on the same pre-event window)
response_acceptance.required: restart gates pass, no pre-event signal above its bound, and response peak >= max(response_floor,5*noise_metric)
response_acceptance.failure_policy: Report restart failure or response below numerical floor; do not enlarge amplitude, change the pulse, or relax thresholds after seeing results

source_integral_reference.method: Analytical rectangular Gaussian area integral minus adaptive 1D quadrature of the cylinder exclusion; sin^2 temporal integral is duration/2
source_integral_reference.scope: Applied source per unit out-of-plane depth; not net fluid momentum change, which also depends on boundary forces and fluxes

freeze_policy: Written and hashed before any Time solver execution for this experiment. Preserve failures and actual readback; changes require a new explicitly versioned experiment.
